normal.name: The Boss Rush Network
normal.text: What happens when the games we love disappear forever? 🎮 In this clip from the Boss Rush Podcast, Corey Dirrig, LeRon Dawkins, and Andre Wilson explore the growing fight to preserve video game history as digital storefronts close, licenses expire, and online servers shut down. normal.name: Jags-O-Lantern
normal.text: So odd to me that the best-selling Castlevania game ever (Lord of Shadow) didn't even sell 2 million units. Castlevania's very name inspired the whole metroidvania genre, and yet some of those who were inspired by it outsold it by SO MUCH. Dead Cells and Ori and the Blind Forest sold over 10 million copies. Hollow Knight sold 15 million copies. Like Darth Vader said to Ben Kenobi: "When I left you, I was but the learner. Now I am the master" 😄 #Gaming #castlevania #metroidvania
